# Pull Request

By contributing, you agree that your contribution is dedicated to the public domain under the repository's [CC0 1.0](../LICENSE) license.

## Description

What does this PR add or change, and why?

Fixes # (issue)

### Type of change

* [ ] New prompt
* [ ] Update to an existing prompt
* [ ] Documentation only

### Checklist

* [ ] Folder name follows the `<PREFIX>-<ShortName>` convention
* [ ] `README.md` in the folder follows the template in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
* [ ] The prompt names the product version and API revision or module version it targets
* [ ] I have run the prompt through at least one LLM and listed which one(s) in the README
* [ ] Any example output is sanitised (no hostnames, credentials, or internal details)
* [ ] I added or updated the row in the root `README.md` index
